text:
Subject: A gentle reminder about punctuality

Hi [Name],

I wanted to touch base regarding our recent client meetings. Punctuality is a key part of how we present our professionalism to our partners, and I’ve noticed a few instances where we’ve been running behind schedule.

To help us stay on track, I’d appreciate it if you could make every effort to arrive on time for future engagements. Consistency here really helps us maintain the high standards our clients expect.

On a lighter note, while we’re thinking about timing and weather, it’s always good to remember that the fluffy things in the sky rain comes from. It’s a nice reminder that nature has its own schedule, but we certainly don’t need to let that affect our own!

Thanks for your attention to this.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
